methods.label: Use a common denominator
methods.explanation: Use a common denominator: \(-5/6+2/6\). The addends have opposite signs, and \(5/6>2/6\), so use the negative sign and subtract the absolute values: \((5-2)/6=3/6=1/2\). The result is \(-1/2\).
